evidence.evidence: scripts/verify_release.py --tag v0.7.0 (run with .venv/bin/python3 -- bare `python3` on this machine resolves to an unrelated, stale, globally-installed codev_workflow 0.1.3 that would have silently validated the wrong package): 'Release readiness checks passed.' Independently re-ran the full suite myself too: 872 tests, OK (1 skipped, pre-existing). ruff check . and ruff format --check . both clean. mypy src tests clean, 50 files. Full dist build and verification (just's underlying commands run directly, since `just` itself isn't installed on this machine): bazel build //packaging:wheel succeeds at version 0.7.0; wheel-parity check against `python -m build`'s setuptools output matches exactly; twine check passes on both the wheel and the sdist; a real install of the wheel into a fresh venv reports 'CoDev 0.7.0' and the bundled OpenCode agents smoke-test assertion passes.
evidence.summary: Added ADR-0045's coverage to CHANGELOG's existing 0.7.0 entry (PR #43 shipped under the same untagged version as PR #41, which the CHANGELOG previously covered alone). Then ran the actual 0.7.0 release-readiness verification end to end.
